product.title: boAt Rockerz 411, 40Ms Low Latency, 40Hrs Battery, 40Mm Drivers, ENx Tech, App Support, Bluetooth Headphones, Wireless Over Ear Headphone with Mic (Bold Blue)
product.customers_say: Customers find these headphones to be a quality product with amazing sound quality and good battery life, considering them worth the price. The Bluetooth connectivity and performance receive mixed feedback - while some report stable connections, others experience connectivity issues, and some units stop working after one month of use. Comfort and noise cancellation also get mixed reviews, with some praising the premium feel while others find them uncomfortable, and while some appreciate the noise cancellation, others report poor performance in this area.

feedback_topics.name: Quality
feedback_topics.text: Customers find these headphones to be of good quality.

feedback_topics.name: Sound quality
feedback_topics.text: Customers praise the headphones' sound quality, with one customer specifically mentioning the deep bass.

feedback_topics.name: Value for money
feedback_topics.text: Customers find the headphones worth the price.

feedback_topics.name: Battery life
feedback_topics.text: Customers are satisfied with the headphones' battery life, with one customer noting they can wear them for hours.

feedback_topics.name: Bluetooth connectivity
feedback_topics.text: Customers have mixed experiences with the Bluetooth connectivity of these headphones, with some reporting good connectivity and amazing range, while others experience connection issues.

feedback_topics.name: Comfort
feedback_topics.text: Customers have mixed opinions about the headphones' comfort, with some praising the premium feel and soft cushions, while others find them uncomfortable, particularly noting pain in the ears after extended use.

feedback_topics.name: Performance
feedback_topics.text: Customers have mixed experiences with the headphones' performance, with some finding them really impressive while others report that they stop working after one month of use, particularly noting issues with the mic failing after two months and wires breaking after seven months.

feedback_topics.name: Noise cancellation
feedback_topics.text: Customers have mixed experiences with the headphones' noise cancellation, with some finding it better than expected while others report it's not good.
